response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT cr.raceId, COUNT(*) AS entries, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults cr GROUP BY cr.raceId), avg_e AS (SELECT AVG(entries) AS a FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, c.country, COALESCE(p.total_points, 0) AS total_constructor_points, p.entries AS number_of_entries, p.entries - avg_e.a AS difference_from_average FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN avg_e JOIN races r ON r.raceId = p.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE p.entries > avg_e.a ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
